currentParagraphText: “Try to stop it from touching the ground,” Artemis said.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Try to stop it from touching the ground,” Artemis said.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake did as asked and attempted to catch it with his foot like it was a falling balloon, but the moment it touched his foot, he felt as if he’d just tried to stop the fall of a dwarf star. His foot was pushed down and nearly crushed between the floor and the cotton ball before Artemis moved her own foot and pushed Jake’s out of the way.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Taking another moment to inspect the cotton, Jake indeed saw nothing wrong with it. It didn’t even have any energy of note but was a perfectly ordinary and uninteresting fluffy little thing. Handing it back to Artemis by placing it on her palm, she promptly flipped it over as it began floating toward the ground slowly.
